integrity: All cited earlier exact mean formulas attributed to their authors. Self-review only, no independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous reflected one-dimensional Brownian motion, coincident deterministic starting/reset site, fixed positive Poisson reset rate, and cumulative visitation retained across resets; earlier mean formula already known. title: An exact discontinuous optimal reset-site transition for Brownian interval cover times
